description: List every level of every building in floor order: id, name, floorIndex, building (parentId), role (occupied storey, roof-only level or support level), child count, gradeStanding (at-grade, partly-below-grade or below-grade against the ground line and the terrain), isGroundLevel, and which one the person is viewing (isActive); groundLevels names, per building, the level at grade (levelId, whether the building names it, floorElevation, gradeElevation, floorOverGrade, seated). A roof-only level is the roof, not a storey.
name: list_levels
title: List levels
